intro.text: A river of the Elendel Basin and the Roughs.

description.text: Goods travel on it to and from Elendel, and a major railway linking Elendel with cities such as Vindiel-Cameux, Doriel and New Seran follows its course, crossing it again and again on big lattice bridges. The river is wide and its banks are thickly settled.
Rising somewhere in the Roughs, it runs northwest in a straight line through the Seran Range, where it has carved gorges and canyons, then on to Elendel and the Sea of Yomend. Its water is ice-cold.
